lines.japanese: とは言うものの。
lines.english: That said...

lines.japanese: 世に跋扈するチャラい男とは逆の、たとえば聖人君子のような男性なら、小鳩の見識を深めるために会話することを許可しよう。
lines.english: I would allow Kobato to converse with a man who was the opposite of all the sleazy playboys infesting the world—say, a paragon of virtue—so she could broaden her horizons.

lines.japanese: そう。これまでは神格レベルの小鳩に対して、俺の連れてきた男があまりに俗人すぎた。
lines.english: Yes. Until now, the men I had brought before the divine Kobato were far too mortal.

lines.japanese: だから今日は、神と謁見することを許された偉大なる聖人を連れてきた。彼ほどの逸材は、人類史上においても稀である。
lines.english: Today, therefore, I had brought a great saint worthy of an audience with a goddess. A specimen like him was rare in all human history.

lines.japanese: というわけで！　小鳩の世界を広げちゃうぞシリーズ！
lines.english: And so! Operation Broaden Kobato’s World!

lines.japanese: 羽田の叔父さん叔母さんは共働き。つまりこの時間なら、俺と小鳩と三人きりで話が出来るのだ。
lines.english: Uncle and Auntie both worked. In other words, at this hour, Kobato, our guest, and I could talk alone together.

lines.japanese: 「あ、あの、それではお茶をどうぞ」
lines.english: “Um, h-here's your tea.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、ワリーね。ったく、妹の方はホントいい子なのに……フレイムバーズのみんなを振りはらうの、どんだけ大変だったと思ってんだ、このバカ！」
lines.english: “Hey, thanks. Man, the little sister really is the good one... Do you have any idea how hard it was to shake the Flame Birds, you idiot?!”

lines.japanese: 「あはは、ごめんね森里君。ささ、ハサミでも持って」
lines.english: “Ahaha, sorry, Morisato. Here, have some scissors.”

lines.japanese: 「持たねえよ！」
lines.english: “Like hell!”

lines.japanese: 「あははっ」
lines.english: “Ahaha!”

lines.japanese: 今日のゲストに呼んだのは、空翔ける天空の騎士・マイベストフレンドの森里君。この薔薇色系男子・羽田ヨージに、勝るとも劣らない完璧男子だ。
lines.english: Today's guest was my best friend, Kazuma Morisato, a knight of the heavens who soared across the sky. He was a perfect man, every bit the equal of this rose-colored young gentleman, Youji Haneda.

lines.japanese: 普段は畏まってしまう人見知りの小鳩も、気負いのない笑顔。森里君の威徳と言わざるを得ない。
lines.english: Even shy little Kobato, who usually stiffened around strangers, wore an easy smile. It could only be Morisato's saintly influence.

lines.japanese: あまりのイケメンぶりに小鳩が惚れてしまわないか心配だが、真実の愛を見極めるためには、遅かれ早かれ通らなねばならぬ試練だ。
lines.english: I worried that his overwhelming good looks might make Kobato fall for him, but sooner or later she would have to face this trial if she was ever to recognize true love.

lines.japanese: 「森里さんって、楽しいかたですね」
lines.english: “You're a fun person, Morisato.”

lines.japanese: 「あーいいって、そんなキンチョーしなくて。羽田からしょっちゅうハナシ聞いてるし」
lines.english: “Hey, relax. No need to get all nervous. Haneda talks about you all the time.”

lines.japanese: 「私も兄と話してて、いちばん名まえをきくのが森里さんなんです」
lines.english: “My brother talks to me about you more than anyone else too.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、なんせ森里君は俺の一番の親友だからな。もしかしたら小鳩のお兄ちゃんになるかもしれないひとだぞ」
lines.english: “Of course. Morisato's my very best friend. He might even become your big brother someday.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、ならねえよ。どこ探したってなれる可能性がねえよ」
lines.english: “No, I won't. There is no conceivable way that could happen.”

lines.japanese: 「あははっ」
lines.english: “Ahaha!”

lines.japanese: おお、小鳩が笑ってる！　なかなか人前では小さく笑うことしかできない小鳩が！
lines.english: Oh! Kobato was laughing! In front of other people, she could usually manage only the tiniest smile!

lines.japanese: 「兄があまりに毎日話すので、まるで何度も会ってるかのようです」
lines.english: “My brother talks about you every day, so it feels as if we've met many times before.”

lines.japanese: 「へー、そうなんだ。つか、どんなこと話してんのか知ンねーけど、そんな大したやつじゃないよ俺」
lines.english: “Huh, really? Dunno what he's been telling you, but I'm not that big a deal.”

lines.japanese: 「そんなことないよ！　森里君は服のセンスもいいし、流行に敏感だし！　ファッションに気を使う男、くぅ～、惚れるぅー！」
lines.english: “That's not true! You have great taste in clothes, and you're always on top of the latest trends! A man who cares about fashion—nnngh, irresistible!”

lines.japanese: 「あ、それ私も知ってます。兄と買い物に行ったときですよね」
lines.english: “Oh, I know that story too. That was when you went shopping with my brother, right?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、一年の時な。つか、そんなことまで知ってんの？」
lines.english: “Yeah, back in our first year. Wait, you know about that too?”

lines.japanese: 「はい。あまりにしょう細にいたるまで話してくれたので、まるで私もその場にいたかのようでした」
lines.english: “Yes. He described it in so much detail, I felt as if I'd been there myself.”

lines.japanese: 「えっと、店員さんと森里さんがなかよくて、イベントとかのハガキももらったりしてるって」
lines.english: “Um, you and one of the store clerks are friends, and they send you postcards about events and things.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、そうそう。あの店、よくクラブでイベントなんかやるんだよ。レディースもあっから、こんど羽田と一緒に三人で行く？」
lines.english: “Oh, right. That store holds club events all the time. They carry women's clothes too, so wanna go with me and Haneda sometime?”

lines.japanese: 「ええっ！　あ、でも私、せれ、せれくとしょっぷ？　とか、ぜんぜん分からないんです……」
lines.english: “What?! Oh, but I don’t know anything about... boo—boutiques?”

lines.japanese: 「かかか、最初はみんなそんなもんだって。でも二、三回通ってるうちに慣れてきて、そうすっと店員さんとも知り合いになって、新作情報とかも教えてくれるわけ」
lines.english: “Kakaka, nobody does at first. You get used to it after two or three trips, then you get to know the clerks and they start telling you about new releases.”

lines.japanese: 「ほ、ほほー、そういうものですか」
lines.english: “O-ohhh. So that's how it works.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ森里さんとなら、一回だけ行ってみようかな……」
lines.english: “Then maybe I'll try going once, if it's with you...”

lines.japanese: おおお、あの引っこみ思案の小鳩を外にまで引っぱりだすとは！　さすが森里君、その魅力はさながら人間孔雀だね！
lines.english: Ohhh! He had coaxed the painfully shy Kobato right out of the house! As expected of Morisato. That charm of his made him a human peacock!

lines.japanese: 「そうだよ、森里君に付いていけば安心だからね！　ようし、それじゃ俺も張りきって付いていっちゃうぞう！」
lines.english: “Exactly! You'll be safe as long as you stick with Morisato! All right, then I'm coming along at full throttle!”

lines.japanese: 「お、お兄ちゃんは、はずかしいから来なくていい」
lines.english: “B-Big Brother, you'd embarrass me, so you don't have to come.”

lines.japanese: 喜び勇む俺を前に、小鳩はぶんぶんと首を横に振った。
lines.english: Kobato shook her head hard at my triumphant enthusiasm.

lines.japanese: 「なんで？」
lines.english: “Why?”

lines.japanese: 「だ、だってお兄ちゃんに買い物見られるの、なんかはずかしいし」
lines.english: “B-because having you watch me shop would be kind of embarrassing.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、分かるよ。家族と服買いに行くなんて、きっちーよな」
lines.english: “Yeah, I get it. Clothes shopping with family is brutal.”

lines.japanese: 「ど、どうしてだ小鳩。いいじゃないか、お兄ちゃんがいたって。べつに恥ずかしいことなんかないぞ」
lines.english: “Wh-why, Kobato? There's nothing wrong with Big Brother coming. You have nothing to be embarrassed about.”

lines.japanese: 「い、いい。お兄ちゃんはいいっ」
lines.english: “N-no. I don't want you there.”

lines.japanese: 小鳩に拒否られた！
lines.english: Kobato rejected me!

lines.japanese: 「いやいや、そこは兄貴だから分かってやんなきゃ。俺なら母親と一緒に買い物なんか死んでもやだね」
lines.english: “Come on, you're her brother. You oughta understand. I'd rather die than go shopping with my mom.”

lines.japanese: 「です、ですよね」
lines.english: “R-right.”

lines.japanese: 死んでもやだって言われた！
lines.english: She said she'd rather die!

lines.japanese: ま、まさか小鳩のやつ、すでに森里君の魅力に魅せられて！？　そういえばさっきから森里君も、俺に対する態度と違って小鳩に優しいような……あわわわわわ。
lines.english: C-could Kobato already have fallen captive to Morisato's charms?! Come to think of it, Morisato had been much kinder to her than he ever was to me... Awa-wa-wa-wa.

lines.japanese: 「あー、コバッティほんといい子だよな。つかその……ゴメン」
lines.english: “Man, Kobatty really is a great kid. And, uh... sorry.”

lines.japanese: 「はえ？　なにがですか？」
lines.english: “Huh? For what?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、なんでもない。今度さ、メシおごらせてよ。さっきも言ったけど、いつもハナシ聞いてっから、他人ってカンジしねーし」
lines.english: “Nah, nothing. Let me buy you dinner sometime. Like I said, I hear about you all the time, so you don't really feel like a stranger.”

lines.japanese: 森里君が小鳩を誘ってる！
lines.english: Morisato was asking Kobato out!

lines.japanese: 「は、はい。それじゃ買い物へ行ったときに」
lines.english: “O-okay. Then when we go shopping.”

lines.japanese: 小鳩がデートの誘いをＯＫしてる！
lines.english: Kobato accepted his date invitation!

lines.japanese: こっ、これはまずい……いずれ銀河戦争の鍵さえ握るほどの美男美女ふたりが、いまお近付きになろうとしている……！
lines.english: Th-this was bad... A beautiful man and woman who might one day hold the very key to a galactic war were about to become acquainted...!

lines.japanese: やばいぜ、なんとか阻止しなけりゃ、大宇宙マクロコスモスの歴史が乱れちまう！
lines.english: Shit! Unless I stopped them, the history of the cosmic macrocosm would fall into chaos!

lines.japanese: 「あ、そだ。たなの中に、まだおかしあるから出しますね」
lines.english: “Oh, right. There are still some snacks in the cabinet. I'll bring them out.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、いいってば、そんな気ぃ使わないで」
lines.english: “Hey, don't worry about it. You don't have to fuss over me.”

lines.japanese: 宇宙レベルの非常時だと言うのに、森里君と小鳩はお菓子だの悠長な話をしている。なんて呑気な。親友と妹じゃなければ、痛いと言うまで鼻の穴を捻りあげているところだ。
lines.english: A cosmic emergency was unfolding, yet Morisato and Kobato were idly discussing snacks. How carefree. If they hadn’t been my best friend and my sister, I would have twisted their nostrils until they said it hurt.

lines.japanese: 「いやー、よかったな羽田。こんな、よく出来た妹がいてさあ、かかか」
lines.english: “Man, you've got it good, Haneda. A kid sister this perfect? Kakaka.”

lines.japanese: 「よく出来てなどいない！」
lines.english: “She is not perfect!”

lines.japanese: 俺は銀河の平和を守るため、なんとか森里君に小鳩を諦めさせようと思った。
lines.english: For the sake of peace in the galaxy, I had to make Morisato give up on Kobato somehow.

lines.japanese: 「え……なに言ってんの。すげえイイ子じゃん」
lines.english: “Huh...? What're you talking about? She's an amazing kid.”

lines.japanese: 「イイ子などではないっ！　森里君は知らないからそんなこと言えるんだ。小鳩のヨゴレっぷりと言えば、神話の神々が慄くほどの汚れ。英語に訳せばビッチアス！」
lines.english: “She is not! You can only say that because you don't know her. Kobato's corruption is so profound, the gods of myth tremble before her filth. In other words: BITCH-ASS!”

lines.japanese: 「えっ」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「ちょ……おまえ、なんてこと言うんだよ。可哀想じゃねーか」
lines.english: “Hey... What the hell, man? That's a horrible thing to say.”

lines.japanese: 「可哀想じゃないっ！　小鳩の存在は宇宙を滅ぼしかねない、人智を超えた汚らわしさだ！」
lines.english: “It is not! Kobato's existence is an uncleanliness beyond human comprehension that may destroy the universe itself!”

lines.japanese: 「はあ？　おまえいつも言ってること全然ちげーじゃん。今日だって女神みたいな美しさだとか、妹さんの鼻があと３センチ高かったら歴史が変わってたとか言ってたし」
lines.english: “Huh? That's the exact opposite of what you always say. Just today, you called her as beautiful as a goddess and said history would have changed if your sister's nose were three centimeters higher.”

lines.japanese: 「なにいいいっ！？」
lines.english: “WHAAAAT?!”

lines.japanese: し、しまった、そんな重要機密を森里君に漏らしていたとは。紛うことなき事実ではあるが、ここは大宇宙マクロコスモスのために全否定しなくては！
lines.english: C-crap. I had leaked vital state secrets to Morisato. They were indisputable facts, but for the sake of the cosmic macrocosm, I had to deny them completely!

lines.japanese: 「う、うちの小鳩はかわいくなどないっ！」
lines.english: “M-my Kobato isn't cute at all!”

lines.japanese: 「ふえっ……」
「うちの小鳩より不細工な生き物など、地球にひとつとして存在しない！　立てば爆薬、座ればドカン、歩く姿は尻の穴だ！」
lines.english: “There isn't an uglier creature on Earth! When she stands, TNT; when she sits, kaboom; when she walks, an asshole in bloom!”

lines.japanese: 「さあ森里君！　ここは俺に任せて、君は目が潰れる前に、俺の部屋の布団へ逃げるんだ！」
lines.english: “Now, Morisato! Leave this to me and flee to the futon in my room before the sight destroys your eyes!”

lines.japanese: そのとき森里君をかばうようにして立った俺は見た。
lines.english: I stepped between them to shield Morisato—and then I saw it.

lines.japanese: 口を∞の形にゆがめる小鳩の顔を。
lines.english: Kobato's mouth was twisted into a figure eight.

lines.japanese: 「うええええん、お兄ちゃんのばかあああ！」
lines.english: “WAAAAH! Big Brother, you IDIOT!”

lines.japanese: 「ああっ、小鳩！？」
lines.english: “Wait, Kobato?!”

lines.japanese: 「いや、まあ……あとでちゃんと謝っといた方がいいと思うよ」
lines.english: “Yeah, uh... I think you should apologize properly later.”

lines.japanese: その後、俺は森里君の勧めに従ってもりもり謝った。
lines.english: Afterward, I took Morisato's advice and apologized my heart out.
